context: A uni intern interviews a manager about brand renewal
purpose: Teach: 撤去/法定/スローガン/任期/速やか/命名/デフォルト/稼動

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はブランド刷新についてお話を伺えればと思います。まず、旧ロゴの撤去はもう終わったんですか？
lines.en: Today I'd like to ask about your brand renewal. First, has the removal of the old logo been completed?
lines.style: Polite intern opening, slightly nervous but professional tone with clear articulation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、店舗の看板は法定の手続きを踏んでから、先月までに速やかに撤去しました。
lines.en: Yes, after going through the legally required procedures, we promptly removed all the store signage by last month.
lines.style: Measured corporate voice, confident and informative with steady business cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しいスローガンの命名には、どなたが関わられたんでしょうか？
lines.en: Who was involved in coming up with the naming for the new slogan?
lines.style: Curious follow-up question, leaning forward with genuine interest in the process.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社長の任期中の目玉企画なので、役員全員で案を出し合いました。命名そのものは外部のコピーライターさんですけどね。
lines.en: Since it's the flagship project during the president's term, all the board members contributed ideas. The actual naming was done by an outside copywriter, though.
lines.style: Explanatory and slightly amused, sharing insider details with controlled warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。社内システムのデフォルト画面も、新ロゴに切り替わったんですか？
lines.en: I see. Has the default screen of the internal system also been switched to the new logo?
lines.style: Engaged follow-up, voice rising with genuine curiosity about the implementation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もちろん。サーバーは二十四時間フル稼動で、全端末のデフォルト設定を一斉に更新しました。
lines.en: Of course. The servers were running at full operation for twenty-four hours, and we updated the default settings on all terminals at once.
lines.style: Proud and matter-of-fact, slightly impressed by the team's efficiency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: すごい稼動体制ですね。最後に、このスローガンに込められた思いを伺ってもいいですか？
lines.en: What an impressive operational setup. Finally, may I ask about the meaning behind this slogan?
lines.style: Wrapping up respectfully, voice softer with genuine admiration and closing curiosity.
